title: Create Kura world seed-state harnesses from CUJs for Vaporize simulation proof
createdBy: codex after operator corrected database/Turso framing to Kura world seed states derived from CUJs

historicalContent.sourceLocation: Codex session 2026-06-26: operator corrected that the milestone should use Kura, and create seed states from CUJs to simulate the world.
historicalContent.description: Vaporize needs a Kura world seed-state harness that turns critical user journeys into simulated world state. CUJs are the canonical source records: each CUJ defines an actor, intent, preconditions, actions, outcomes, tags, and metadata. The harness materializes those CUJs into a Kura seed-state document plus a receipt so tests can simulate product worlds without centering the design on a database engine.

implementedFirstSlice.vaporizeReceipt: vaporize.cli@wrkstrm-core.clia.sh test --package-path private/universal/substrate/collectives/wrkstrm-core/private/apple/spm/vaporize@wrkstrm-core.cli --configuration debug -- --filter VaporizeCUJ21KuraWorldSeedStateTests passed 3 tests

acceptanceCriteria: Shared test support can derive Kura world seed-state records from CUJs.
Each CUJ-derived seed record preserves actor, intent, preconditions, actions, outcomes, tags, and metadata.
Fixture preparation writes cujs.json, kura-world.seed-state.json, and kura-world.seed-state.receipt.json.
The receipt identifies storageFamily as kura and sourceKind as critical-user-journey.
The active CUJ21 proof does not expose Turso, libSQL, databaseURL, or database-engine language.
Future integration with kura@kura-org.sd or Kura Sync Node remains explicitly gated and receipt-backed.
knownSeparations: This slice produces Kura seed-state documents for simulation; it is not a production Kura service adapter.
Kura/Vaults Org owns the storehouse and data-engine family. Vaporize owns the proof harness and receipt lane.
Database engines are implementation details behind Kura integration, not the board-facing abstraction.
